title: Split-thickness skin graft
summary: Harvest a split-skin graft from the thigh and apply it to a clean wound.

steps.title: WHO Time Out
steps.prompt: Before skin incision for a split skin graft to the right shin, the team pauses. What must be confirmed aloud?

choices.text: Patient identity, the procedure, the site and side, and antibiotics given in the last 60 minutes
choices.feedback: Correct: the Time Out confirms who, what and where, and that prophylaxis is in.

choices.text: Only that the consent form is signed
choices.feedback: The signature alone does not prevent wrong-site surgery.

choices.text: Nothing: the site was marked on the ward
choices.feedback: Marking does not replace the Time Out.

steps.hint: The site is the right thigh donor, right shin recipient. All three phases of the WHO checklist are mandatory.

steps.title: Pick up the skin preparation
steps.hint: Alcoholic chlorhexidine, applied from the incision site outwards.

steps.title: Prepare the skin over the donor thigh
steps.hint: Centre outwards, wider than the incision; let it dry fully before drapes and diathermy (it is flammable).

steps.title: Which graft?
steps.prompt: Large clean wound on the shin. Which graft?

choices.feedback: Correct: covers large areas, takes reliably.
Limited donor sites; used for face and hands.

steps.title: Lubricate the donor site and set the knife depth
Spread the graft
steps.hint: Dermis down, onto the recipient bed.

steps.title: Lay the graft on the shin wound

choices.text: A collection (blood or seroma) under it, shear, or infection

steps.title: Dress with a tie-over or compression dressing
